HdrPostFragHlsl = "// target hlsl dx12\nint2 shadyTextureSize(Texture2D<float4> image, int level) {\n  uint width, height, levels;\n  image.GetDimensions(level, width, height, levels);\n  return int2(width, height);\n}\nint2 shadyTextureSize(Texture2D<uint4> image, int level) {\n  uint width, height, levels;\n  image.GetDimensions(level, width, height, levels);\n  return int2(width, height);\n}\n// from hdrPostFrag\n\ncbuffer ShadyUniforms1 : register(b1) {\n  bool framebufferYDown;\n  float exposure;\n};\n\nTexture2D<uint4> toneFlags : register(t0);\nSamplerState hdrInputSampler : register(s1);\nSamplerState toneFlagsSampler : register(s0);\nTexture2D<float4> hdrInput : register(t1);\n\nfloat3 pbrNeutral(float3 radiance);\n\nfloat3 pbrNeutral(\n  float3 radiance\n) {\n  float3 result;\n  // Khronos PBR Neutral, operating on exposed linear radiance.\n  float x = min(radiance.r, min(radiance.g, radiance.b));\n  float offset = ((x < 0.08) ? (x - (6.25 * x) * x) : (0.04));\n  float3 value = radiance - (float3) (offset);\n  float peak = max(value.r, max(value.g, value.b));\n  if (peak < 0.76) {\n    result = value;\n    return result;\n  }\n  float newPeak = 1.0 - 0.0576 / ((peak + 0.24) - 0.76);\n  value = value * (newPeak / peak);\n  float desaturation = 1.0 - 1.0 / (0.15 * (peak - newPeak) + 1.0);\n  result = lerp(value, (float3) (newPeak), desaturation);\n  return result;\n}\n\nstruct PSInput {\n  float4 pos : SV_POSITION;\n  float2 postUv : TEXCOORD0;\n};\n\nfloat4 PSMain(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET {\n  float2 postUv = input.postUv;\n  float4 fragColor = float4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n  float2 sampleUv = postUv;\n  if (framebufferYDown) {\n    sampleUv.y = 1.0 - sampleUv.y;\n  }\n  uint flag = (toneFlags.Load(int3(int2(sampleUv * float2(shadyTextureSize(hdrInput, 0))), 0))).r;\n  float4 sampleValue = hdrInput.Sample(hdrInputSampler, sampleUv);\n  float3 value = sampleValue.rgb;\n  if (flag == uint(2)) {\n    value = pbrNeutral(value * exposure);\n  }\n  if (! (flag == uint(0))) {\n    value = float3(pow(max(value.r, 0.0), 0.45454545454545453), pow(max(value.g, 0.0), 0.45454545454545453), pow(max(value.b, 0.0), 0.45454545454545453));\n  }\n  fragColor = float4(value, sampleValue.a);\n  return fragColor;\n}\n"
